free_tier.stated: free endpoint with no API key: 45 requests a minute per IP address on /json (15 a minute on /batch, up to 100 IPs a batch), plain HTTP only
free_tier.notes: HTTPS and API keys need the Pro plan, EUR 13.3 a month when paid for 12 months

per_object_cap.stated: a batch request takes up to 100 IP addresses

interface_detail: GET http://ip-api.com/json/{ip} (also xml, csv, line, php), POST http://ip-api.com/batch with a JSON array of up to 100 IPs; the same path over HTTPS answers HTTP 403 SSL unavailable for this endpoint
tooling: any HTTP client; the X-Rl and X-Ttl headers give the remaining requests and the seconds to the window reset
chaining: 45 lookups a minute from one address with no key, or 15 batches of 100 a minute; part of the data falls back to MaxMind GeoLite2. Bulk path: the batch endpoint; no download

limits.value: 45 requests a minute per IP address on /json; 15 a minute on /batch
up to 100 IPs per batch request

identity_cost.detail: no account and no key on the free endpoint

reliability_note: past the per-minute limit the API answers HTTP 429; repeated overruns ban the IP address for up to 1 hour; no HTTPS on the free endpoint
confidence_note: the JSON and batch documentation, the plans page and the terms page were quoted on 2026-10-30; a keyless HTTP lookup answered HTTP 200 and the HTTPS form answered HTTP 403 SSL unavailable. The rate limit was not exhausted to observe it.

evidence.proved: the free endpoint needs no key

evidence.proved: the JSON endpoint allows 45 requests a minute per IP

evidence.proved: the free API has no HTTPS

evidence.proved: a batch takes up to 100 IPs
